⚔️ WarCard

The deck is split evenly between two players. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Each player reveals the top card — higher card wins both.
  2. Aces are high — 2 is lowest, Ace is highest.
  3. In a tie (War), place three cards face-down and reveal the fourth.
  4. The winner of the War reveal takes all stacked cards.
  5. Game ends when one player has all the cards.
